name: Upsell & Cross Sell - AW
summary: Shopify upsell and cross-sell app by Aheadworks: hand-picked or automatic related-product recommendations, frequently-bought-together bundles and one-click add-ons on product pages, cart, checkout, thank-you and post-purchase pages, priced by recommendation clicks.
best_for: Shopify stores that want related-product, upsell and frequently-bought-together recommendations on product pages and cart, with hand-picked control, at a fixed monthly price for a known click volume
skip_if: you want a usable free plan, you get far more than 10,000 recommendation clicks a month and need a published price for that, or you mainly want checkout upsells on a store that is not on Shopify Plus
honest_knock: The meter is recommendation clicks, and the free plan's 50 a month runs out on almost any live store, with the app's branding shown until you pay. The full set of 8 placements, including checkout, thank-you and post-purchase pages, starts on the $49.99 plan; the $29.99 plan stops at 3. The developer page prices extra clicks on the entry plan at $0.012 each but showed no amounts for its higher tiers when we read it, and the listing does not say whether checkout placement needs Shopify Plus. We have not used the app ourselves.

pricing.entry_price_terms: StartUp Upsell · per month, or $299 a year
pricing.notes: (re-read 2026-11-25 on csell.io/pricing and the Shopify listing, unchanged for the first four plans; read 2026-10-11 on the Shopify App Store listing apps.shopify.com/cross-sell and on the developer's own pricing page csell.io/pricing, USD; the listing says all charges are billed in USD and recurring charges every 30 days) Upsell & Cross Sell by Aheadworks is priced by recommendation clicks and by the number of store locations it may appear in. The Free Upsell Plan is $0: cross-sells and upsells in 2 locations, 50 upsell recommendation clicks a month, and Cross Sell branding on the widget. StartUp Upsell is $29.99 a month or $299 a year (the listing says save 17%): 3 locations, 2,500 recommendation clicks a month and no branding. Small Store Upsell is $49.99 a month or $499 a year: all 8 locations and 5,000 clicks a month. MediumStore Upsell is $59.99 a month or $599 a year: the 8 locations plus custom pages and 10,000 clicks a month. Every paid plan has a 14-day free trial. The listing names the 8 locations as including product pages, cart, checkout, order status, thank-you and post-purchase pages. On 25 November 2026 the developer's own pricing page, csell.io/pricing, showed amounts for the two tiers above that: Large Store at $79.99 a month or $799 a year for 50,000 recommendation clicks, and Unlimited at $99.99 a month or $999 a year with no click cap, both with all 8 locations and custom pages. It prints extra recommendation clicks at $0.012 per click on the 2,500-click plan only. The Shopify listing still shows only the first four plans.

schema_offer.description: StartUp Upsell, per month, or $299 a year; 3 locations and 2,500 recommendation clicks a month; Free plan has 2 locations and 50 clicks; Small Store $49.99 (8 locations, 5,000 clicks), MediumStore $59.99 (10,000 clicks). Read on the vendor's own pricing page on 2026-11-25.

free_plan_evidence: The Free Upsell Plan is $0: cross-sells and upsells in 2 locations, 50 upsell recommendation clicks a month, and Cross Sell branding on the widget.

compare_with.name: Selleasy
compare_with.why: Selleasy is in our dossiers too and is metered differently: on our 19 September reading it charged by your store's total monthly orders, free under 50 and $29 above 1,000, with the same features at every step and checkout upsells only on a $49 Pro tier outside the App Store listing. Upsell & Cross Sell - AW charges by recommendation clicks and placements instead. A store with many orders but few clicks on recommendations pays less here; a store whose shoppers click a lot pays less on Selleasy. Count both numbers for your own store before choosing.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Upsell & Cross Sell AW on a Shopify development store: the install, the Free plan, the setup wizard with the app embed saved in the theme, one handpicked upsell seen in the theme editor preview, the plan screens, the locked locations on Free, the Start-Up approval screen (not approved) and the app menu. Nothing was paid, no paid plan was started and nothing was uninstalled. Install: the App Store listing (English) is called Upsell & Cross Sell AW by Aheadworks and says Free plan available. Free trial available., with a rating of 4.8 from 485 reviews; the install screen calls the app Upsell, Cross sell & Bundles and asks for View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data. Install was approved at about 11:15. Plans: straight after the install the app opened an in-app plans screen (Try any paid plan free for 14 days. Cancel anytime.). We chose the Free plan with Start plan. There was NO Shopify approval screen and no charge; the app went straight to a welcome wizard. Core action: the wizard has four steps: language (English), Enable app embed, Enable blocks on pages and Setup complete. Enable application embed opened the theme editor with the message Cross Sell Auto activated, and we SAVED the theme there (Changes saved.), so the app embed Cross Sell Auto is now on in the theme of our development store. In step three we switched on only the Product pages block. The Dashboard then said Your app embed status is: Enabled, You have 0 active app block(s) on your store and Clicks used in this cycle 0 / 50 (0%). Offer: in Assign > Product page > Upsells we pressed Assign products for The Inventory Not Tracked Snowboard and picked The 3p Fulfilled Snowboard, which showed 1 of 15 Cross-Sell(s) Selected. In the theme editor preview of the product page the heading Would you rather like these? appeared with the link Powered by Cross Sell (a brand line on the Free plan) and a card for The 3p Fulfilled Snowboard at $2,629.95 with a plus button. No app block had to be added by hand. Timing, approximate tester observations: about 3 minutes from the start of the install (11:15) to the first offer in the preview (about 11:18), in about 14 clicks. The click counter stayed at 0 / 50 because we did not click the offer, and no order was placed. Plans in the app (monthly): Start-up $29.99 (Visible on first 2 pages, 2,500 clicks monthly, Extra recommendation clicks: $0.01/click, No branding, Upsell pop-up, QuickView button), Small store $49.99 (All 8 types of pages, 5,000 clicks monthly, $0.012/click), Medium store $59.99 (All 8 types of pages, 10,000 clicks monthly, $0.006/click) and Large store $79.99 (50,000 clicks monthly, $0.0016/click). The Free plan row says Visible on first 2 pages, Extra recommendation clicks: $0.026/click and 50 clicks monthly. The screen also has a Yearly and Monthly switch, I have a coupon and Top-up packs $4.0 - 150 clicks. Differences with the listing and the dossier: the listing names 3 locations for Start-up and 2 locations for Free, while the app says Visible on first 2 pages for both; the listing shows no Large store plan, and the app does; the listing names no cost per extra click and no top-up packs, and the app shows both; the Upsell in 8 locations plus Custom Pages of the listing is not repeated in the app. Free plan limits: on the Assign page Cart drawer, One-click upsell, Homepage page, Collection page and Checkout page are blurred with Please upgrade; Upsell pop-up and Cart pages have a switch that was off. The Account page says the Free plan has a click limit of 50 and 50 clicks remaining before cross-sell recommendations are no longer visible; its renewal date is 17 December 2026. That page shows an admin email and was not kept as evidence. Checkout: via Please upgrade and Upgrade we reached the Shopify Approve subscription screen for the Start-Up plan: You will not be billed for this test charge., Cross Sell - Start-Up Plan (Dev Shop), $29,99 USD every 30 days, You have a 14-day free trial ending on 1 Dec., a subtotal and total of $29,99 due on 1 Dec, an Add payment method row and an Approve button. We did NOT approve: the Free plan was already active and the screen also asked for a payment method. We pressed Cancel and Shopify said Charge declined.; nothing was charged and no plan was started. Cancelling: the app menu in the list of installed apps has Open app, View details, Get support and Uninstall, and no way to cancel or downgrade a paid plan; the plans page says Cancel anytime. and shows no cancel button. The FAQ link on the App Store listing opens a help site that says Not Found. We did not click Uninstall. Not tested: any paid plan, offers on the cart drawer, checkout, thank you page or post purchase, clicking the offer in the preview, an order, the upsell pop-up, real analytics, the storefront outside the theme editor, and uninstalling. Clean up: the app stays installed on the Free plan, the app embed Cross Sell Auto is saved in the theme, and the upsell for The Inventory Not Tracked Snowboard still exists. Our own test tabs were closed except one admin tab on the apps list that could not be closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The app shows a price per extra click and top-up packs that the listing does not name, five locations are locked on Free, and there is no way to cancel a paid plan except Uninstall.

exit_test.what: The app was installed on our Shopify development store, which we set up, and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 17 November 2026 the session tested Upsell & Cross Sell AW on a Shopify development store: the install, the Free plan, the setup wizard with the app embed saved in the theme, one handpicked upsell seen in the theme editor preview, the plan screens, the locked locations on Free, the Start-Up approval screen (not approved) and the app menu. Nothing was paid, no paid plan was started and nothing was uninstalled. Install: the App Store listing (English) is called Upsell & Cross Sell AW by Aheadworks and says Free plan available. Free trial available., with a rating of 4.8 from 485 reviews; the install screen calls the app Upsell, Cross sell & Bundles and asks for View customer data, View staff and contributor data and View and edit store data. Install was approved at about 11:15. Plans: straight after the install the app opened an in-app plans screen (Try any paid plan free for 14 days. Cancel anytime.). We chose the Free plan with Start plan. There was NO Shopify approval screen and no charge; the app went straight to a welcome wizard. Core action: the wizard has four steps: language (English), Enable app embed, Enable blocks on pages and Setup complete. Enable application embed opened the theme editor with the message Cross Sell Auto activated, and we SAVED the theme there (Changes saved.), so the app embed Cross Sell Auto is now on in the theme of our development store. In step three we switched on only the Product pages block. The Dashboard then said Your app embed status is: Enabled, You have 0 active app block(s) on your store and Clicks used in this cycle 0 / 50 (0%). Offer: in Assign > Product page > Upsells we pressed Assign products for The Inventory Not Tracked Snowboard and picked The 3p Fulfilled Snowboard, which showed 1 of 15 Cross-Sell(s) Selected. In the theme editor preview of the product page the heading Would you rather like these? appeared with the link Powered by Cross Sell (a brand line on the Free plan) and a card for The 3p Fulfilled Snowboard at $2,629.95 with a plus button. No app block had to be added by hand. Timing, approximate tester observations: about 3 minutes from the start of the install (11:15) to the first offer in the preview (about 11:18), in about 14 clicks. The click counter stayed at 0 / 50 because we did not click the offer, and no order was placed. Plans in the app (monthly): Start-up $29.99 (Visible on first 2 pages, 2,500 clicks monthly, Extra recommendation clicks: $0.01/click, No branding, Upsell pop-up, QuickView button), Small store $49.99 (All 8 types of pages, 5,000 clicks monthly, $0.012/click), Medium store $59.99 (All 8 types of pages, 10,000 clicks monthly, $0.006/click) and Large store $79.99 (50,000 clicks monthly, $0.0016/click). The Free plan row says Visible on first 2 pages, Extra recommendation clicks: $0.026/click and 50 clicks monthly. The screen also has a Yearly and Monthly switch, I have a coupon and Top-up packs $4.0 - 150 clicks. Differences with the listing and the dossier: the listing names 3 locations for Start-up and 2 locations for Free, while the app says Visible on first 2 pages for both; the listing shows no Large store plan, and the app does; the listing names no cost per extra click and no top-up packs, and the app shows both; the Upsell in 8 locations plus Custom Pages of the listing is not repeated in the app. Free plan limits: on the Assign page Cart drawer, One-click upsell, Homepage page, Collection page and Checkout page are blurred with Please upgrade; Upsell pop-up and Cart pages have a switch that was off. The Account page says the Free plan has a click limit of 50 and 50 clicks remaining before cross-sell recommendations are no longer visible; its renewal date is 17 December 2026. That page shows an admin email and was not kept as evidence. Checkout: via Please upgrade and Upgrade we reached the Shopify Approve subscription screen for the Start-Up plan: You will not be billed for this test charge., Cross Sell - Start-Up Plan (Dev Shop), $29,99 USD every 30 days, You have a 14-day free trial ending on 1 Dec., a subtotal and total of $29,99 due on 1 Dec, an Add payment method row and an Approve button. We did NOT approve: the Free plan was already active and the screen also asked for a payment method. We pressed Cancel and Shopify said Charge declined.; nothing was charged and no plan was started. Cancelling: the app menu in the list of installed apps has Open app, View details, Get support and Uninstall, and no way to cancel or downgrade a paid plan; the plans page says Cancel anytime. and shows no cancel button. The FAQ link on the App Store listing opens a help site that says Not Found. We did not click Uninstall. Not tested: any paid plan, offers on the cart drawer, checkout, thank you page or post purchase, clicking the offer in the preview, an order, the upsell pop-up, real analytics, the storefront outside the theme editor, and uninstalling. Clean up: the app stays installed on the Free plan, the app embed Cross Sell Auto is saved in the theme, and the upsell for The Inventory Not Tracked Snowboard still exists. Our own test tabs were closed except one admin tab on the apps list that could not be closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: The app shows a price per extra click and top-up packs that the listing does not name, five locations are locked on Free, and there is no way to cancel a paid plan except Uninstall.
